title: Proton-pump inhibitor-induced hypomagnesemia: current research and proposed mechanisms
authorConflicts: The authors have no conflicts of interest to report.
result: Narrative review. Observational studies associate PPI exposure with lower serum magnesium, but no prospective controlled studies support causation. Proposed mechanism: active intestinal magnesium uptake through TRPM6 and TRPM7 decreases at higher luminal pH; renal magnesium is conserved in PPI-associated hypomagnesaemia.
